items.title: Conflict of Interests Among Stakeholders (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Conflict of Interests Among Stakeholders (PDF 114, printed 110).

blocks.text: Jab stakeholders ki tarjeehat mukhtalif hon to takrao (conflict) paida hota hai. Karobar nayi ijaad aur munafe ke liye data jama karna chahte hain, jab ke users apni zaati maloomat ki privacy aur us par ikhtiyar chahte hain. Hukoomaton ko maeeshat ki tarakki aur shehriyon ke huqooq ki hifazat aur akhlaqi miyar mein tawazun rakhna hota hai.

Takrao ki aam misaal data jama karne ka tareeqa hai. Companies AI ki performance behtar karne ke liye users ka bohat sa data jama kar sakti hain, lekin wazeh ijazat (explicit consent) ke baghair yeh privacy aur bharose ki khilaf-warzi hai. Shaffaf data policies aur aasan ijazat ke tareeqe kaam aur akhlaqiyat mein munsifana tawazun laate hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Privacy aur nayi ijaad mein tawazun aaj ki technology wali duniya ke sab se bare challenges mein se ek hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Company ki meeting ka role-play karein jis mein developers user data jama karna chahte hain aur privacy ke hami (advocates) is ki mukhalifat karte hain. Hal par baat karein.

blocks.caption: Kis ki kya tarjeeh?
rows: Innovation aur munafe ke liye data jama karna
Privacy aur apni maloomat par ikhtiyar
Maeeshat ki tarakki aur shehriyon ke huqooq mein tawazun

blocks.prompt: Data jama karne mein takrao (conflict) kaise hota hai aur kitab is ka kya hal batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Companies AI behtar karne ke liye bohat sa data jama karti hain; wazeh ijazat (explicit consent) ke baghair yeh privacy aur bharose ki khilaf-warzi hai. Hal: shaffaf (transparent) data policies aur aasan consent ke tareeqe.
